title: adidas FIFA World Cup 26™ Trionda Soccer Ball
features: The adidas FIFA World Cup 26 Trionda Training Soccer Ball finds inspiration from the iconic "la ola" wave among the crowd. A machine-stitched construction ensures a soft touch, and a butyl bladder provides lasting shape retention for every practice.
SOFT AND DURABLE: Machine-stitched construction ensures a soft touch and high durability
KEEPS ITS SHAPE: Butyl bladder for best air retention
REQUIRES INFLATION: Ships flat, pump not included
FIFA QUALITY AND OFFICIALLY LICENSED: Officially licensed by FIFA, the ball passed FIFA tests on circumference, weight, rebound and water absorption
